title: Shape and size of the arenas affect amphipod behaviours: implications for ecotoxicology.
note: OSF j7b52 (public node 67hkx, no licence set) holds continuous video-tracking measures of individual amphipods (distance, velocity, zone duration, % mobility per 2-min bin); not item responses.

title: Identifying risk zones and landscape features that affect common leopard depredation.
note: Leopard depredation GIS/landscape data: locations and landscape covariates, no respondents or items.

title: Relationship between the cost of illness and quality of life among adolescents with type 1 diabetes-a mixed method study.
note: Raw file (MOESM3_ESM.xlsx, 113 x 72) carries a Name column with adolescent patients' first names. Would have failed anyway: DSQoL subscale/total scores only, no per-item responses.

title: Association of workplace bullying and burnout with nurses' suicidal ideation in Bangladesh.
note: SI MOESM2 csv (CC BY 4.0 article SI), no id or PII -> row index. Split per the paper into S-NAQ-9 (1-5), BMS-10 (1-7) and SIDAS-5 (0-10); 3 exact double-entry rows dropped (1264 -> 1261). Tables: kabir_2023_snaq, kabir_2023_bms10, kabir_2023_sidas. Sibling PLOS ONE paper Chowdhury 2022 (10.1371/journal.pone.0274965) likely shares respondents; its figshare holds only regression tables.

title: Working memory filtering at encoding and maintenance in healthy ageing, Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.
note: Data on OSF node 3s6ze, which is private (api.osf.io/v2/nodes/3s6ze/ returns 401; the DAS says registration through personal credentials is required), so the article's CC BY 4.0 does not reach it. SI is one docx of summary/ANOVA tables. Weak fit anyway: continuous angular-error recall, n=28 per group (~112 total); not logged to license_blocked_candidates.csv.

title: Understanding public perceptions toward sustainable healthcare through psychological network analysis of material preference and attitudes toward plastic medical devices.
note: OSF 5etma is public but has no licence (node_license null, no parent). Strong otherwise: .sav, 1,598 finished x ~70 Likert items with Dutch labels. Logged to license_blocked_candidates.csv.

title: Validation of the shortened 24-item multidimensional assessment of interoceptive awareness, version 2 (Brief MAIA-2).
note: SI xlsx holds raw per-item MAIA-2 (Polish) responses, 37 items 0-5 for 323 respondents, plus composites and the Polish questionnaire. One table (the Brief MAIA-2 is a 24-item subset of the same columns). Two fractional imputed cells dropped. Table: rogowska_2023_maia2.

title: The effects of everyday-life social interactions on anxiety-related autonomic responses differ between men and women.
note: OSF d3tg5 is public and CC BY 4.0, but Manuscript_data.Rda has only 96 unique participants. The one item-level block is 10 repeated state-anxiety items across 1,536 EMA prompts (1-8); trait questionnaires are sums only.

title: Well-Being at the University: The Contribution of Social and Emotional Competence and Self-Care Practices as Seen by Students.
note: Already blocked in PMC batch 3 (private MDPI OSF node, no licence; license_blocked_candidates.csv row 2026-09-23). Resurfaced because download_failed rows are not ledgered as seen.

title: The Anxious Mind: Examining the Conflicting Relationships Between Distinct Aspects of Social Anxiety and Social Cognition.
note: N=78 children analysed (97 recruited). The data node OSF 87ew5 is also private (401) despite the DAS saying openly available; SI is only a PDF of item wording.

title: School water, sanitation, and hygiene (WaSH) intervention to improve malnutrition, dehydration, health literacy, and handwashing: a cluster-randomised controlled trial in Metro Manila, Philippines.
note: DAS: data available on request from the corresponding author and "will be made available" on ZEF GeoNetwork (daten.zef.de does not resolve); no deposit or licence found. SI is an intervention description only. 756 children at baseline; item-level status unverified. Not logged to license_blocked_candidates.csv (nothing inspectable).

title: WeChat usage and preservation of cognitive functions in middle-aged and older Chinese adults: indications from a nationally representative survey, 2018-2020.
note: Only SI file (MOESM1_ESM.xlsx, 8x7) is an aggregate table of WeChat use by age and gender; the item-level data are CHARLS, which is registration-gated.

title: Modelling the significance of celebrity endorsement and consumer interest on attitude, purchase intention, and willingness to pay a premium price for green skincare products.
note: 4 of 10 construct blocks (CIC, CIA, ATA, ATS) carry fill-down corruption (e.g. CIC rows 33-64 all 5,5,4,5,5) and disagree with the deposit's own construct means on 44-71 rows each; ID column non-unique (84 values over 778 rows, some masked). The other 6 blocks (ECT/ECP/ECD/ECE 1-5, SCPI/WPPP 1-7) match their composites, but not shipped on corpus-trust grounds (Chen 2023 precedent).

title: The paradox of plastic bag legislation: How bans and taxes affect PM2.5 air pollution in 208 countries.
note: Country-year panel of PM2.5 and policy indicators across 208 countries; no respondents or items.

title: Controlling Rater Effects in Divergent Thinking Assessment: An Item Response Theory Approach to Individual Response and Snapshot Scoring.
note: Data are the shared J Intell special-issue dataset (OSF a9qnc, Forthmann & Myszkowski 2024, CC BY 4.0, N=202), already in IRW as Forthmann-2024-cleverness_ratings and Forthmann-2024-creative_quality. Duplicate.
